messages:
maria: Heads-up — after the kernel-selection RFC landed in main I see a p99 uplift in the attention microbench for some seq-lengths. Anyone else seeing the same? :eyes:
kai: saw it too. p50 unchanged, p95 small delta, but p99 jumped ~18% on A100-40G runs.
devon: can you paste the bench command + config? different batch/kv-warmup?
maria: running: `./bench_attn --model llama-13b --kernels=auto --seq=1024 --batch=1 --iters=2000 --warmup=200`
sam: are you testing with the new kernel-priority order from the RFC? we changed fallback order which could force slower kernels for unlucky shapes.
maria: yes, main uses the new priorities. I also repro'd on a dedicated node (same stack).
anya: quick checklist proposal before deep dives: 1) reproduce on nightly harness 2) isolate kernel choice mapping per shape 3) add deterministic seeds + perf counters 4) run correctness diffs on logits/topk
kai: +1. Also add a throughput (tokens/s) run with higher batch to see if it's tail-only or affects avg.
devon: triage plan: step 1 reproduce single-seed w/ `--deterministic` and `--log-kernel` to capture which kernel used each step. step 2 run `--compare-to=pre-rfc-build` to collect relative deltas.
maria: example log snippet I got: 
```
[bench] seq=1024 step=120 kernel=matmul_v2 fallback=slow_split p99=12.4ms
[bench] seq=1024 step=121 kernel=fused_attn_v1 p99=9.6ms
```
devon: that indicates occasional fallback to `slow_split` at certain sequence lengths. Could be kernel selection heuristic threshold.
sam: hypothesis: selection rule uses peak memory estimate that now prefers a safer kernel for some micro-batches. If memory estimate off by allocation fragmentation, fallback triggers.
anya: tests to run today (assign): maria -> run nightly harness reproducer and capture `--kernel-trace`. kai -> add telemetry counters for fallback reasons (OOM vs heuristic) in the runtime. devon -> run microbench that toggles the selection thresholds (0.9x, 1.0x, 1.1x) and compare p99. sam -> try a synthetic run to force fragmentation (random-sized allocations).
maria: starting harness now. leaving logs here when done. FYI bench-bot queued a nightly job: deploy message below.
bench-bot: nightly-bench queued: job=attn_kernels/1767001234, node=A100-40G-3, commit=main@7f2c9d :white_check_mark:
kai: if we confirm selection bug, short-term mitigation: pin kernel mapping for affected seq ranges in config so we use the previous kernel order. Long-term: expose a more explicit fallback policy + a calibration job.
devon: for correctness we should diff logits with `--gold=pre-rfc` and check max-abs-diff <= 1e-5 and topk-match >= 99.9%. If diffs are non-zero we need to halt rollout.
maria: harness finished quick run: p99 med spike observed at steps 110-140. attached `kernel-trace` shows `slow_split` used 7% of those steps. I'll upload full dump to the bench bucket (s3://redwood-bench/tmp/1767001234/).
sam: thanks. I glanced at logs — fallback reason field is `heuristic_mismatch` not `oom`. That supports the selection rule regression hypothesis.
kai: added a telemetry patch (PR 4321) to include `selection_score` and `fallback_reason` in traces. Can we run a run with that?
maria: re-running now with kai's patch. Also adding `--stress-alloc` to mimic fragmentation.
anya: decision rubric for whether to revert: - p99 regression >= 10% AND fallback_reason != intentional policy -> revert/patch. - correctness diffs > threshold -> immediate rollback. - otherwise pin config and continue incremental rollout.
devon: one gotcha — nightly harness sample distribution is heavier on long seqs than production. We should weight decision by production distribution. I'll pull prod sample weights.
maria: patch run results: telemetry shows selection_score for `fast_fused` dropped below threshold at seq ~1024 when batch=1; fallback_reason=heuristic_mismatch; p99 delta ~20%.
sam: ok. let's pin kernel mapping for seq=[900,1100] to prefer `fast_fused` and trigger a canary rollout to validate.
kai: I'll cut a hotfix config PR and add a canary policy (5% traffic) + automatic rollback if p99 > baseline+7% in canary.
anmary: (typo) meant to say maria: ack.
maria: created PR #4330 with pin config + smoke tests. Running canary in internal cluster.
bench-bot: canary-deploy started: config=pr-4330, scope=internal, pct=5, monitor=canary_p99, deadline=30m
devon: parallel follow-ups: - add unit test for selection boundaries - add simulation harness that replays allocation patterns - update RFC to include a calibration job and a deterministic selection mode
anya: assigning owners in issue: maria (repro + canary), kai (telemetry + rollout), devon (tests + sim), sam (investigate allocator effects).
maria: one more note: please include the bench command and exact commit hashes when posting threads. Saves time.
kai: noted. thanks everyone. If canary passes we'll merge hotfix and schedule a proper follow-up RFC update. :thumbsup:
maria: thanks all. closing thread, will post postmortem once we've validated canary.
